content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail: Start digital

Traditional payment processors impose significant fees and geographic restrictions, leaving many creators unable to monetize their digital goods. For instance, Gumroad charges 10% on each sale, while NOWPayments only charges 0.5%. This means that with 100 sales per month on a $97 product, the fee difference retains $921 in your pocket. By utilizing infrastructure designed for sovereignty, you circumvent these limitations, ensuring that your sales are not only possible but also profitable.
What You Need Before You Deploy

To get started, gather the essential tools for your digital commerce stack. You will need a hosting service like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, a backend logic solution such as Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, and a storage option like Supabase or Google Sheets. Additionally, setting up your payment processing with NOWPayments will allow you to accept more than 300 cryptocurrencies, providing flexibility and reducing fees. Make sure to have your digital products ready for upload, including ebooks, courses, or templates.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Begin by deploying your chosen infrastructure. For example, if you opt for the Sovereign Starter Stack, set up GitHub Pages for hosting and integrate Google Apps Script for backend workflows. Connect NOWPayments to handle crypto transactions seamlessly. The payment confirmation will trigger automated delivery of the digital product, ensuring that your customers receive their purchases instantly. This streamlined process not only enhances user experience but also minimizes manual intervention.
Avoid high fees by choosing NOWPayments over traditional platforms.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once your infrastructure is in place, it’s time to launch. Test your setup with a real transaction to validate the flow from payment to product delivery. Ensure that the webhook from NOWPayments fires correctly upon payment confirmation. This step is crucial for ensuring that your customers receive their digital products without delay. Promote your online store via social media or other channels to attract your first customers and begin generating sales.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

After successfully processing initial transactions, focus on scaling your operations. Utilize the Complete Builder Kit for additional blueprints and templates that can enhance your store’s capabilities. Consider expanding your product offerings to include more ebooks, courses, or digital assets. Monitor your sales and customer feedback to refine your approach. Leveraging the infrastructure you’ve built will allow you to grow sustainably while maintaining full control over your operations.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

To sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe, you can set up an independent online store using a sovereign digital commerce infrastructure. By utilizing tools like GitHub Pages for hosting and NOWPayments for payment processing, you eliminate reliance on traditional platforms and their fees, enabling direct sales to your audience.
Retain full control of your digital sales without relying on third-party services.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

If you’re exploring ways to sell digital downloads without platform fees, consider the Complete Builder Kit ($197) available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html. This kit includes all necessary blueprints and templates to establish a fully functional digital commerce stack, empowering you to operate independently.
Your Deployment Checklist

Build your product before you build your store — the product is the point, not the infrastructure. Once your product is ready and in delivery-ready format, create your NOWPayments account and configure wallet addresses. Choose Stack 01 for self-deployment following the Blueprint, or Stack 02 for COREMERCH deployment. Upload your product file to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 and note the file path. Configure the product in your backend with the file path, USD price, and delivery email template. Build your product page on the storefront with clear product description, pricing in USD, and the checkout flow. Run a complete mainnet test. Check that the download link works and expires correctly after the configured time period.

You can sell an ebook by setting up a sovereign digital commerce infrastructure using GitHub Pages for hosting and NOWPayments for payment processing. This approach allows you to retain full ownership and control over your sales.

Can I sell templates and fonts without using Gumroad or Payhip?
Yes, you can create your own online store using platforms like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, and process payments through NOWPayments, bypassing the need for Gumroad or Payhip.
What cryptocurrencies can I accept for my digital products?
With NOWPayments, you can accept over 300 cryptocurrencies, giving your customers the flexibility to pay in their preferred digital currency, including popular options like Bitcoin and Ethereum.
How can I ensure automated delivery of my digital products?
By using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, you can set up automated workflows that deliver your digital products immediately upon payment confirmation through NOWPayments.
